spanish: Y harás sus platos y sus cucharas y sus jarras y sus tazones que se derrama en ellas; oro puro harás a ellos.

findings.issue: Hophal imperfect 3ms is rendered as present indicative; passive voice, third person, and singular are kept, and the tense is smoothed.

אשר plus a 3ms passive verb plus בָּהֵן is a resumptive relative (something is poured in them). que se derrama en ellas can be read with plural tazones as the subject, and ellas does not agree with masculine tazones.

notes: Conjunction, both 2ms make-verbs, four plural 3ms vessel suffixes, gold, pure, and the 3mp object match the tokens.
